about: 0130 A1-A2: when a Haiku `same` on two entity names merges by itself. Measured 2026-11-07 on 277 labelled pairs Haiku called the same: the lab's experiment 2 (dev 70, test 92, test2 65; two blind Opus labellers and a referee) and the owner's queue answers (50). A row is automatic only when its right/n meets the bar; every other `same` stays in the review queue. Change a row here, not the code (markx/identity.py reads it).

second.about: A held-back `same` whose every reason has a second row that is on, at >= min_conf, is asked again: the same guide (alias-v1) with two other example posts per name. Both `same` at >= min_conf: automatic, with its redirect (undoable). A disagreement stays in the queue, marked. Measured: these merges 71/71 right (held out of the guide's writing: 64/64), against alias-v2 (a stricter second-opinion guide) 78/79.

rule_type.about: v10.18: a pair a name rule (squash, maker_prefix, handle, anchor, fields) proposes across two types (or an org and a product family) is Haiku's to decide: asked when unasked; Haiku's answer in apart_relations at >= apart_min_conf keeps it apart by itself (its open queue item closed, kept); any other not-`same` (part, other_version, cant_tell, or a lower confidence) stays queued (haiku_unsure); `same` is held as any `same` with a type mismatch. Measured 2026-11-14 on the server's 304 open rule-proposed items (Haiku asked on the 281 never asked; one blind labeller, disputes refereed): `different` >= 0.8 kept apart 160/160 right (Wilson 97.7-100%); `part` >= 0.8 10/16 (a company and its same-name product: often one page), so `part` stays queued. Off: every such not-`same` stays queued.

third.about: 0201 (identity.third): a Haiku `same` still queued after both opinions and the chain guard, for a reason listed here, is asked alias-v2 (alias3: each side's known facts, the accounts naming it, four posts with wider windows). Its `same` >= same_min_conf merges ('third', past the chain guard's two-groups rule, never past 6 names a cluster); its answer in apart_relations >= apart_min_conf keeps the pair apart; anything else stays queued with it. Measured 2026-11-14, blind, held out: chain-held pairs, alias-v2 `same` >= 0.8: 76/77 right (98.7%, Wilson 93.0-99.8%), it decides 77 of 88; weak first answers (below_bar): `same` >= 0.85 12/15, so below_bar is not listed; `apart` never measured (alias-v2 said it once in 168): off.
third.apart_about: v10.18 round 4: Sonnet's not-`same` on the weak class (alias4) at >= 0.7: 36/36 right (Wilson 90.4-100%) on 160 held-out weak items (all its not-`same` answers labelled: 120 + 40 more); below 0.7 it is 24/32. Chain-held: alias-v2 said apart once, never measured: no row. Version-held with Sonnet: same >= 0.9 28/28 (low 87.9%), >= 0.8 42/45; apart 11/11 (low 74.1%): not listed.
third.below_bar: v10.18 round 3: a weak first `same` (< 0.85, no second opinion) asked alias-v2 with Sonnet (kind alias4, `models`): `same` >= 0.8 67/68 right (98.5%, Wilson 92.1-99.7%) on 120 held-out items, the second 60 alone 34/34; it fires on 68 of 120. Sonnet's not-`same` 31/32 (Wilson low 84.3%): apart stays off. Haiku's alias-v2 on the same class: 12/15, off.

models.about: v10.18: the model a kind is asked with when not the worker's own --model (the server names it on each leased task; identity.model_for). Measured per kind: alias4 (the weak `same` class) with Sonnet, above.

facts.about: 0184 (markx/entity_facts.py): identity facts. on: the readers read them and the stage writes them (makers from stated mentions; the facts of a settled collision answer); place: a bare name's new mention placed in a sense by rule (stated maker, shared source or co-named entity), else marked wait and its entity asked; split: a split two runs agree on becomes sense entities with their mentions pinned (else queued for the owner, as before); backfill: bare names with 2+ posts and no facts are asked, cap a run. Off until the switch-on bars of 0184 are met on frozen sets (plan/issues/0184). Measured 2026-11-14: place (rule 1, the stated maker) 53/54 (98.1%, Wilson low 90.2%) on held-out server collisions: on (it acts only once `on` is); rule_context 140/171: off; rule_handle: no person rows on the copies (18 rows, all orgs): off, unmeasured; split 54/54: off until the owner switches `on`.

repairs.about: 0164 (markx/entity_repair.py): the identity repairs each run. org_family: a product family merged into an org is cut apart (automatic redirects undone; never the owner's). reparent: a version whose family is an org gets a family entity. families: families differing only by their maker's name or brand merge, then their same versions. suffix: orgs one once a corporate suffix goes merge only with min posts naming one beside the other's things (unmeasured: off sets the alias questions alone to decide). shown: the name and type shown, by evidence. product_accounts (0164 B): an org-typed name that is a family's maker in front of the family's name merges into the family.

timeline.about: 0165 (markx/components.py, markx/rename.py): components: a mention named '<product> <name>' whose post is about the name links to the name's own entity under the product (off until measured: mentions moved, 40 read). renames: two entities of one maker, one older, sharing an own address, a 'formerly' sentence or the new one's post naming the old, are asked (rename-v1) and Haiku's `renamed` queued for the owner, never merged by itself (rename_cap questions a run).

rows.why: v10.18, the server's queue 2026-11-14 (blind labels, disputes refereed): a `same` held for its types (a name rule's pair 47/48, a Haiku pair 39/39) with both opinions >= 0.85; 2/2 before. 98.9%, Wilson 93.9-99.8%
